stability: mixed: 2 - Stable (TracingChannel, AsyncLocalStorage options, worker profiling); 1 - Experimental (boundedChannel, withStoreScope, withScope, startHeapProfile, setHeapProfileNearHeapLimit, probe mode, built-in channels); 1.1 - Active development (inspector DOMStorage)
discrepancies: doc/api/v8.md:383 says v8.queryObjects() is no longer experimental (v25.4.0, v24.13.1), but every tested binary (v24.19.0, v26.13.0, v28.0.0-pre) still emits 'ExperimentalWarning: v8.queryObjects() is an experimental feature' (lib/internal/heap_utils.js:82). Verified by examples/query-objects.mjs.

doc/api/diagnostics_channel.md:731 and :1377 document classes RunStoresScope and BoundedChannelScope, but neither is exported from node:diagnostics_channel (BoundedChannel is). Only instances are reachable.
doc/api/diagnostics_channel.md:1427 has a broken reference link: \[`boundedChannel.withScope([context])`]\[] renders literally.

doc/api/test.md:4239 documents the 'node.test' tracing channel for tests and suites. The runner also publishes start/end with name '<root>' (type 'test', nesting 0) after the tests have run. This is undocumented. Verified by examples/channel-test-runner.mjs.

doc/api/diagnostics_channel.md (boundedChannel.run, ~line 1293) does not say so, but run() sets neither ctx.result nor ctx.error, unlike TracingChannel.traceSync. Behavior is documented in the skill, not a contradiction.
